claims.citation: New York Herald, 30 July 1866, p. 3, col. 3
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Hansa, Oterendorp, Bremen 15th and South-
ampton 18th inst, with mdse and 662 passengers, to Oelrichs
& Co. 21st inst, lat 50 59, lon 25 24, saw steamship Saxonia,
hence for Hamburg; 26th, lat 44 15, lon 56 45, ship Emerald
Isle, from Liverpool for New York; 29th, steamships Her-
mann and Allemania, bound E.
